newsitem.title: USA: First West Virginia to merge subsidiaries.
newsitem.headline: First West Virginia to merge subsidiaries.

text.p: First West Virginia Bancorp Inc said on Thursday that it filed an application with the Comptroller of the Currency to merge First West Virginia and its wholly owned subsidiary banks.
The subsidiary banks, Progressive Bank of Wheeling, W. Va. and Progressive Bank -- Bellaire, Ohio, will be merged into one business, pending regulatory approval, the company said.
The merger of the units is expected to be completed during the third quarter of 1997, First West Virginia said.
